home_assistant.title: Home Assistant
home_assistant.text: These links open my.home-assistant.io, which forwards you to the right page in your own Home Assistant. The first time, it asks for your Home Assistant address.
home_assistant.integration_text: Adds a meal plan calendar, a “Today” sensor and the “Meal plan” card. Download it from the Marketplace (HACS before Home Assistant 2026.11), restart Home Assistant, then set it up.
home_assistant.app_title: Install Rezeptplaner on another Home Assistant
home_assistant.app_text: Send this link to anyone who wants to install Rezeptplaner. If it doesn't work, add the repository first.
